prerequisites: Before joining a language group at a particular level, the student must first attain the preceding level, i.e. A1 before joining an A2 group, A2 before joining B1, B1 before joining B2, B2 before joining C1 and C1 before joining C2.

learning_outcomes.text: is able to communicate appropriately in foreign language at B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) in everyday life, in academic and professional environments
is able to cooperate in international team
has knowledge of grammatical structures and lexical resources needed to communicate in foreign language in terms of general and specialist language related to field of study

is able to obtain and process information related to field of study and academic instruction environment in foreign language at B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
is equipped to participate in lectures, seminars and laboratory classes conducted in foreign language

syllabus_topics: Talking about learning foreign languages; discussing health and happiness; describing processes
Conditionals; debating; the language of emotion; talking about quantity and amount
Accepting and rejecting ideas; predicting; justifying opinions; relative clauses
Describing charts and graphs; writing reports; describing visual information; compound nouns
Language of advertisements; modals (future); for and against arguments; describing uses
Collocations; discussing safety; compound adjectives; agent nouns
Comparison and contrast; modals (past); emphatic structures; shapes, measurements and descriptions of objects
Introduction to presentations; persuading; discussing hypothetical ideas; descriptions of objects
Writing a formal letter; describing information; talking about differences and similarities; reading complex texts; giving definitions
Business terms and expressions; expressing opinions; discussing technological advances; explaining safety procedures
Past forms and narrative tenses; word sets; articles and the use of the passive; describing emergency procedures
Talking about success; idioms; asking about the way and giving directions
Making offers and bargaining; talking about needs and expectations; conceding points; obtaining information asking questions
Negotiating a contract; writing e-mails and leaflets; improving listening and dictionary skills; talking about properties of materials
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for writing, speaking, and tests is 60.0%.
